Notable records

A handful of records that still stand or have only just been broken:

  • Highest score, modern era — Salvador Sobral, Portugal, 2017. 758 points with "Amar pelos dois" — the only ballad to ever win in the modern split-jury era.
  • Most wins by a single artist — Johnny Logan, Ireland. Won as performer in 1980 ("What's Another Year") and 1987 ("Hold Me Now"), then again in 1992 as songwriter for Linda Martin.
  • Most consecutive wins — Sweden, 2012 + 2023 by Loreen. First and only artist to win Eurovision twice as performer.
  • Biggest televote landslide — Kalush Orchestra, Ukraine, 2022. 439 audience points (max possible was ~480 that year) — the highest ever, riding wartime solidarity.
  • First contest, 1956 — Switzerland (Lys Assia, "Refrain"). Only seven countries competed; voting was kept secret. The full results were never published.
